fixes: Key organization chat view by account, role, work domain, organization and organization role; old view state is not carried into a new scope
Reuse ChatViewWorkRegistry to abort uploads on view disposal or conversation changes; stale success, failure, notification and cleanup are ignored
Merge file upload and native path import under one synchronous active-work lock, shared quota checks and completion handling
Block sending with the same synchronous upload lock before React busy state renders
Guard the initial conversation lookup before binding so a late initial result cannot replace a newer accepted conversation

cancels paths on conversation rollover and closure without carrying pending files
does not let a late initial conversation lookup rebind or cancel a newer upload
isolates late files results across account and organization changes

keeps files valid across language changes, handles failure and cancels on unmount
keeps paths valid across language changes, handles failure and cancels on unmount
serializes files with the other upload entry and blocks sending until receipt
serializes paths with the other upload entry and blocks sending until receipt

validationNotes: StrictMode exposed nondeterministic Vitest dynamic-import mocking, which invoked the real Tauri module. The UI test now evaluates the unchanged production native listener through existing source_expression with an explicit native dependency; no production workaround was added.
Initial lint caught direct access to a typed toast mock; changed the test to vi.mocked and reran focused tests, lint and frontend builds.
Temporary native error diagnostic was removed; the helper including its original line endings matches the prune38 SHA-256 exactly.
limitations: Tests mount the React view with synthetic transport and socket/native dependencies; no real desktop upload, real account or model API was exercised.
Client abort cannot undo files already accepted and archived by the server; this change prevents carrying their result into another view.
The initial history lookup is guarded; this batch does not claim all same-conversation socket history refresh ordering is solved.
Business code decreased by 6 lines, new regression tests add 120 lines: total increased by 114.
